title: Do you ...? (present simple questions)
summary: Вопросы в present simple: **Do you ...? Does he ...?** + подлежащее + глагол в начальной форме; краткие ответы **Yes, I do. / No, she doesn't.**
ru:
## Как задать вопрос
В present simple вопрос строится с помощью **do / does** — он ставится **в начало**, а основной глагол остаётся в начальной форме.
> You work in a bank. → **Do you work** in a bank? — Ты работаешь в банке?
> She plays tennis. → **Does she play** tennis? — Она играет в теннис?

## Какую форму выбрать
- **Do** — с **I / we / you / they** и множественным числом
- **Does** — с **he / she / it** и одним человеком или предметом
> **Do** your friends live near here? — Твои друзья живут рядом?
> **Does** Chris play tennis? — Крис играет в теннис?
После does глагол **без -s**: ~~Does she plays?~~ → Does she **play**?

## Порядок слов
**(вопросительное слово) + do/does + подлежащее + глагол**
> **Where do** your parents **live**? — Где живут твои родители?
> **How often do** you **wash** your hair? — Как часто ты моешь голову?
> **What does** this word **mean**? — Что значит это слово?
> **How much does** it **cost**? — Сколько это стоит?
Со словами частоты: **Do you always have breakfast?**

## Особый вопрос
> **What do you do?** — Кем ты работаешь? (= What's your job?)
> — I work in a bank.

## Краткие ответы
> Do you play tennis? — **Yes, I do.** / **No, I don't.**
> Does George work hard? — **Yes, he does.** / **No, he doesn't.**
> Do they speak English? — **Yes, they do.** / **No, they don't.**
Повторяем только **do / does**, а не основной глагол.

## Типичные ошибки
- ~~You work in a bank?~~ → **Do you work** in a bank?
- ~~Does she plays?~~ → Does she **play**?
- ~~Do he like music?~~ → **Does** he like music?
- ~~Where you live?~~ → Where **do you live**?
- ~~Yes, I like.~~ → Yes, I **do**.
en:
## How to ask a question
In the present simple we use **do / does** at the start of a question. The main verb is in its base form.
> You work in a bank. → **Do you work** in a bank?
> She plays tennis. → **Does she play** tennis?

## Do or does?
- **Do** — with **I / we / you / they** and plural nouns
- **Does** — with **he / she / it** and singular nouns
> **Do** your friends live near here?
> **Does** Chris play tennis?
After does there is no -s on the verb: ~~Does she plays?~~ → Does she **play**?

## Word order
**(question word) + do/does + subject + verb**
> **Where do** your parents **live**?
> **How often do** you **wash** your hair?
> **What does** this word **mean**?
With frequency words: **Do you always have breakfast?**

## What do you do?
> **What do you do?** = What's your job?
> — I work in a bank.

## Short answers
> Do you play tennis? — **Yes, I do.** / **No, I don't.**
> Does George work hard? — **Yes, he does.** / **No, he doesn't.**
We use only **do / does**, not the main verb.

## Common mistakes
- ~~You work in a bank?~~ → **Do you work** in a bank?
- ~~Does she plays?~~ → Does she **play**?
- ~~Do he like music?~~ → **Does** he like music?
structure:
## Вопрос
| Do / Does | Подлежащее | Глагол | |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Do** | I / we / you / they | work? like? have? | Do you like tea? |
| **Does** | he / she / it | work? like? have? | Does he like tea? |

## С вопросительным словом
| Слово | do / does | Подлежащее | Глагол |
|---|---|---|---|
| Where | do | your parents | live? |
| How often | do | you | wash your hair? |
| What | does | this word | mean? |
| What time | does | the film | start? |

## Краткие ответы
| Вопрос | Да | Нет |
|---|---|---|
| Do I / we / you / they ...? | Yes, I / we / you / they **do**. | No, I / we / you / they **don't**. |
| Does he / she / it ...? | Yes, he / she / it **does**. | No, he / she / it **doesn't**. |

## Формулы
> **Do / Does + подлежащее + глагол?** → Does Ann live here?
> **Слово + do / does + подлежащее + глагол?** → Where does Ann live?

## Со словами частоты
> **Do** you **always** have breakfast? · **Does** Chris **often** play tennis?

## Важно
- В вопросе с **be** do не нужен: **Are** you tired? (см. unit 2)
- *do* в «What do you do?» — и вспомогательный, и основной глагол.

items.text: {{Does}} it rain a lot in your city?
What {{do}} they usually eat for breakfast?
Do you play tennis? — No, I {{don't|do not}}.
Do your parents speak English? — Yes, they {{do}}.
Does George work hard? — Yes, he {{does}}.
Does your sister live in London? — No, she {{doesn't|does not}}.
Do you like pizza? — Yes, I {{do}}.
Does the shop open on Sundays? — No, it {{doesn't|does not}}.

items.q: How often ___ you go to the cinema?

options: Always do you get up early?
Do you always get up early?

exercises.title: Составьте вопросы
exercises.instruction: Составьте вопрос из слов. Используйте **do / does**.

answers: Where do your parents live?
Do you always get up early?
How often do you watch TV?
What do you want for dinner?
Does your brother like football?
What do you do in the evenings?
Where does your sister work?
Do you often go to the cinema?

exercises.title: Задайте вопрос другу
exercises.instruction: Задайте вопрос с **Do ...?** или **Does ...?** по образцу.
exercises.example: I like pizza. And you? → **Do you like pizza?**

answers: Do you play football?

items.prompt: I drink tea in the morning. And you?
answers: Do you drink tea in the morning?
Does Ann play chess?

items.prompt: I live near the park. And your friends?
answers: Do your friends live near the park?

items.prompt: You work on Saturdays. And your father?
answers: Does your father work on Saturdays?
Do you speak English?
Does your sister like coffee?
Where do you work?
How much does it cost?
How much does this cost?
What time does the film start?
What time does the film begin?
What time does the movie start?
When does the film start?

exercises.title: Напишите о себе
exercises.instruction: Ответьте на вопросы полными предложениями о себе. Проверьте по образцу.

items.prompt: Do you like English? (Yes, I ... / No, I ...)
items.sample: Yes, I do. I like English.
I'm a student. / I work in a shop.

items.prompt: What time do you usually get up?
items.sample: I usually get up at seven.

items.prompt: Does your best friend live near you?
items.sample: Yes, she does. She lives in the next street.
